verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly documents granular user permissions and role-based approval controls, with direct claims like 'Built-in permissions means our accountant can easily make payments — literally one click and it's done' and 'Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions.' This is corroborated by API-level features (Gate Disbursements, approval-based request-to-send-money) and a 5-year customer's community account describing granular access setups for shared users, supporting real-world use of permission controls. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the one-click approval UI/workflow (rather than just the marketing claim), and detail on configuring which teammates get approver roles.
